description: The fastest possible 2nd TC without villager delay
name: 4:25 2TC Eco Wing
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Add @building_economy/mill.webp@ for @technology_abbasid/fresh-foodstuffs.png@. Now add @building_military/archery-range.png@ and @building_military/barracks.png@ for defensive units.
Take @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (dont chop woodline until 2tc has been built, that means also dont delete any of the 3 straggler trees under the TC)
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ & pull gold vills to wood when gold mine is 3750/4000 @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to protect and then you decide if you wanna stay feudal or go FC.
Remacro after clicking age up, at 75 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ move to @resource/resource_stone.png@
@landmark_abbasid/military-wing.webp@ Military wing - Use free units to harass or secure 2nd tc spot if vs aggressive civ
Rally to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ when enough resources build @building_economy/town-center.png@
Go for @age/age_3.webp@ if not under pressure
If under pressure, mass @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and try to push for @age/age_3.png@ for @technology_abbasid/composite-bows.png@ and veteran archer upgrade
@landmark_abbasid/culture-wing.webp@ Culture wing - if pinned inside your base
@landmark_abbasid/military-wing.png@ Military wing - if culture in feudal
Ideal army @unit_abbasid/ghulam-3.webp@@unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.png@ but make counter to what is on the field
Take @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (dont chop woodline until 2tc has been built, that means also dont delete any of the 3 straggler trees under the TC)
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ & pull gold vills to wood when gold mine is 3750/4000 @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to protect and then you decide if you wanna stay feudal or go FC.

description: A simple way to mass a lot of units as abbasid. Cheap vills and a sub 5-min golden age give you a significant eco boost early to push out more units.
name: Abbasid 1TC Feudal Aggression
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Add 1 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@ (construct a @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ with this vill)
Leave all vills on @resource/berrybush.webp@. Rest of @resource/sheep.png@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then woodline.
Send army units aggressive. Build @building_military/stable.webp@ and add @building_economy/house.png@ until @age/goldenagetier1.png@

description: The most optimal way to play military wing: Stable into 2nd TC timing around 5:35 into full feudal aggression.
name: Military Wing 2TC
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Take 4 from @https://age4builder.com/img/berrybush.webp@@https://age4builder.com/img/rally.png@ +1@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerAD.png@ @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@), Gather 100@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcewoodicon.png@ then go to woodline.
When gold mine is 3825 (75@resource/resource_gold.webp@in bank) go with the 4@resource/resource_gold.png@@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerAD.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@
Time to make production buildings and balance eco with focus on wood and food. Goal is to boom on 2tc with maximum amount of feudal pressure. When 200/200 pop go age 3.
Add 1 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@ (construct a @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ with this vill)
Rally Wood. Leave all vills on @resource/berrybush.webp@. Rest of @resource/sheep.png@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then woodline.
Drop off stone when 850/1200 then build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@
From here on out, you are most likely going to be playing mass units. Add on more production.

author: Valdemar1902

notes: 4 @https://age4builder.com/img/villagerAD.webp@ to @https://age4builder.com/img/berrybush.png@</img>, 2 @https://age4builder.com/img/villagerAD.png@</img> to build a @https://age4builder.com/img/gristmill.png@</img> and a @https://age4builder.com/img/house.png@</img>

description:
A build Order I took from Whamen's youtube channel, reviewing Beasty's games from One Trick Poney tournament. 18:47 on the video. Works well against cav and aggro civs.

I think this build is a nice middle ground between the safety of early defense with Military Wing and the eco boost given by Eco Wing. You have to be quite on par with the timing though.

I still did not manage to make Valdemar's 4:25 2TC eco wing build work while this one helped me a lot so maybe it can help other players.
name: Beasty's 2TC Eco Wing
author: Hannibarka

notes: @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@. Build @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ + @building_economy/house.png@ with it then send back to @resource/sheep.png@
Next 4 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@. Build @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ with the first one

Leave 5 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.png@, rest of @resource/resource_food.png@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ go to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 5 @resource/resource_wood.png@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@ until enough for 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@ (245 stone). Build @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ on @resource/resource_stone.png@
Build a @building_economy/house.webp@ when needed with a @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@.

After mining 150 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for @technology_abbasid/fresh-foodstuffs.png@ and @technology_abbasid/fertile-crescent-2.png@, send @resource/resource_gold.png@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@
Research @technology_abbasid/fresh-foodstuffs.webp@ and @technology_abbasid/fertile-crescent-2.png@ as soon as you hit @age/age_2.png@
When you mined 245 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, send @resource/resource_stone.png@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to wood until 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@

Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ defensively near your main @building_economy/town-center.png@. You can leave some @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ to get your first prod building faster. (Optional)

When 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ is build, remacro 8 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ on @resource/resource_food.png@, rest to @resource/resource_wood.png@ and build prod buildings accordingly to defend
After your first defense building is done, get @age/goldenagetier1.webp@ asap with houses to connect your base.
When you have enough units to defend, remacro some @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@

Rush + boom + timing? This build does it all

author: Valdemar1902

notes: Immediately move 4 @resource/berrybush.webp@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ and @resource/rally.png@ new @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@

Send @landmark_abbasid/military-wing.webp@: 2x@unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@2x@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ towards enemy base to harass, but if enemy is rushing you, then keep them at your 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@ to defend
